output_list.criticism: setExchange function is public and can be called by anyone, making it easier for hackers to manipulate the isOpened flag. This makes isOpened flag easily accessible to hackers and can be used to perform other malicious operations.

Selling token will reduce totalSupply which could eventually make the token devalue. The current formula of calculation is sellPrice = msg.value / amount. If the contract owner decide to sell all available tokens to maximize the profit, he will actually receive more money than he actually sold.
